text: 4.57 General Provision Policy relating to Gem Replenishment Authorisation and scheme for gold/ silver/platinum jewellery is given in FTP. Application in respect of export promotion scheme for gems & jewellery sector shall be made to concerned Regional Authority as per Appendix 4A.
